Route-linked pWW0 XylF. Native unpurified assay evidence; source describes serine/histidine hydrolase and catechol plus 3-methylcatechol ring-product substrates, Km values of 85 and 13.6 µM. Primary mutant mechanisms must remain construct-qualified.

CF600 DmpG route-linked terminal aldolase in biological DmpFG 2+2 tetramer. Native purified activity, Mn2+ stimulation and Zn2+ inhibition. PMID 8419288 establishes NADH stimulation, contradicting native REG-5876 minus; lesser NAD+ stimulation. Metal/allosteric essentiality and nucleotide binding mechanism are not established by the 1993 experiments. Preserve heterodimer catalytic-pair versus complete tetramer and crystal-unit distinctions.

CF600 DmpF route-linked terminal acylating aldehyde dehydrogenase in DmpFG; native purified activity with measured aldehyde alternatives and pH optimum of 8.5. Suggested channeling is not an unqualified causal regulation edge.

Leuconostoc mesenteroides partially purified aldehyde dehydrogenase co-purifying with alcohol dehydrogenase, NAD-specific not NADP; alternative aldehydes and directional kinetic values. Component activity context only, no molecular-sequence minting.
